svg.text: Payment Service (Online Payments · Gateway Integration · Refunds)
no existing payment for order (unique per order)
1. Charge requires order to exist and be PENDING
2. One payment per order — duplicates rejected (order_id unique)
4. Success → COMPLETED + external tx id + paidAt
5. Refund only allowed from COMPLETED payment
7. Events published after commit → ticketing reacts
no card data stored — method only
